### Operating Envelope {#sec-operating_envelope}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Definition: *"Operating Envelope"*
The operating envelope (deutsch: Arbeitsbereich) refers to the set of operational parameters within which a system operates safely and effectively. It defines the limits of performance, safety, and efficiency, ensuring that operations remain within a range that optimizes key performance indicators (KPIs) such as product quality, operational safety, and equipment efficiency.
:::
